Boundaries.Name: upload-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Start failure-only ownership before preflight when no caller supplies it. Otherwise borrow the enclosing typed owner through acquisition, source reads, retries, reply parsing and mutation/lease cleanup. Successful uploads rent no error observation storage.

Boundaries.Name: upload-cluster-borrower
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow upload ownership through discovery, MOVED/ASK, retirement, replay reset and dedicated connection cleanup. Preserve completed retry counts.
